title: Guideline-as-Oracle: Zero-Annotation Training of an Ophthalmic Telephone Triage Agent
abstract: arXiv:2608.04772v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Scaling supervision for multi-turn medical agents is difficult because expert dialogue annotation is costly and clinical conversations are privacy-restricted. We introduce Guideline-as-Oracle (GAO), which compiles American Academy of Ophthalmology guidance into a 70-row operational rule table and uses it as the sole source of instance-level supervision for 3,000 training dialogues, reserving human labeling for evaluation. Because converting rules into dialogues is itself a design problem, we catalog eight construction strategies, including cited-row tier assignment, one-fact boundary pairs, metadata-only repair, and label repair, and characterize the evidential status of each: labeling mechanism, null, confounded, or evaluated only as a package. Fine-tuning a 9B backbone on this corpus yields GAO-Triage, improving agreement with a 201-case operational reference from 61.7% to 74.1% (exact McNemar p=0.0046) and emergent-case reca

translated_title: 指南即预言机：眼科电话分诊代理的零标注训练
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.04772v2 公告类型：替换-交叉。摘要：为多轮医疗代理扩展监督是困难的，因为专家对话标注成本高昂，且临床对话受隐私限制。我们引入了“指南即预言机”（GAO），该方法将美国眼科学会的指南编译成一个包含70行操作规则的表，并将其作为3,000个训练对话的唯一实例级监督来源，将人工标注保留用于评估。由于将规则转换为对话本身就是一个设计问题，我们整理了八种构建策略，包括引用行层级分配、单事实边界对、仅元数据修复和标签修复，并描述了每种策略的证据状态：标注机制、无效、混淆或仅作为整体评估。在此语料库上微调一个9B骨干模型，得到GAO-Triage，其与201例操作参考的一致性从61.7%提高到74.1%（精确McNemar检验p=0.0046），并且突发案例的召回率有所提升。
tldr: 本文提出“指南即预言机”方法，利用编译的规则表作为唯一监督源，零人工标注训练眼科电话分诊代理，显著提升了与操作参考的一致性及突发案例召回率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Guideline-as-Oracle, which uses a compiled rule table as the sole supervision source for zero-annotation training of an ophthalmic triage agent, significantly improving agreement with operational reference and emergent-case recall.
